steps: Close your dominant hand into a fist with only the thumb extended upward.
Hold the thumb-up fist at chest height in front of your body.
Make one small, firm forward push with the fist, as if nodding approval.
Keep the palm facing inward toward you with the thumb pointing straight up.
Nod slightly with a warm, approving expression as you push forward.
tip: Doubled with both hands it adds extra emphasis — a bigger, warmer 'good'.

steps: Make a closed fist with each hand, extending only the thumbs upward.
Hold your non-dominant thumb-up fist in front of your body.
Lay your dominant thumb on top of the non-dominant thumb.
Brush the dominant thumb upward off the other thumb twice.
Keep both thumbs pointing upward with the palms facing inward throughout.
Finish with a confident, positive expression — you are picking the top choice.
tip: Some signers brush once or slide the thumbs apart — the double brush is the most widely taught form.
